name: Absolute Absorption
summary: The power to absorb everything and anything without limit and utilize it in some way. Sub-power of Omnipotence. Absolute form of Absorption.

name: Absolute Bio-Energetic Sourcing
summary: The power to bio-store an infinite or nearly infinite amount of ambient energy in your body. Technique of Bio-Energetic Sourcing. Variation of Absolute Energy Absorption. Not to be confused with Living Power Plant.

name: Absolute Cosmic Absorption
summary: The power to store an infinite or nearly infinite amount of cosmic energy in your body. Advanced version of Cosmic Energy Absorption. Variation of Absolute Energy Absorption. Not to be confused with Bio-Cosmic Transformer.

name: Absolute Electricity Absorption
summary: The power to store an infinite or nearly infinite amount of electricity in your body. Advanced version of Electricity Absorption. Variation of Absolute Energy Absorption. Not to be confused with Bio-Electric Dynamo.

name: Absolute Electromagnetic Absorption
summary: The power to store an infinite or nearly infinite amount of electromagnetic energy in your body. Advanced version of Electromagnetic Absorption. Variation of Absolute Energy Absorption. Not to be confused with Bio-Electromagnetic Dynamo.

name: Absolute Gamma Absorption
summary: The power to store an infinite or nearly infinite amount of gamma radiation in your body. Advanced version of Gamma Absorption. Variation of Absolute Energy Absorption. Not to be confused with Bio-Gamma Reactor.

name: Absolute Heat Absorption
summary: The power to store an infinite or nearly infinite amount of heat in your body. Advanced version of Heat Absorption. Variation of Absolute Energy Absorption. Not to be confused with Bio-Heat Dynamo.

name: Absolute Ionic Absorption
summary: The power to store an infinite or nearly infinite amount of ionic energy in your body. Advanced version of Ionic Absorption. Variation of Absolute Energy Absorption. Not to be confused with Bio-Ionic Dynamo.

name: Absolute Kinetic Absorption
summary: The power to store an infinite or nearly infinite amount of kinetic energy in your body. Advanced version of Kinetic Energy Absorption. Variation of Absolute Energy Absorption. Not to be confused with Bio-Kinetic Dynamo.

name: Absolute Light Absorption
summary: The power to store an infinite or nearly infinite amount of light in your body. Advanced version of Light Absorption. Variation of Absolute Energy Absorption. Not to be confused with Bio-Photonic Dynamo.

name: Absolute Nuclear Absorption
summary: The power to store an infinite or nearly infinite amount of nuclear energy/connected forces in your body. Advanced version of Nuclear Absorption. Variation of Absolute Energy Absorption. Not to be confused with Bio-Nuclear Dynamo.

name: Absolute Quantum Absorption
summary: The power to store an infinite or nearly infinite amount of quantum energy in your body. Advanced version of Quantum Energy Absorption. Variation of Absolute Energy Absorption. Not to be confused with Bio-Quantum Perpetuator.

name: Absolute Radiation Absorption
summary: The power to store an infinite or nearly infinite amount of radiation in your body. Advanced version of Radiation Absorption. Variation of Absolute Energy Absorption. Not to be confused with Bio-Reactive Perpetuator.

name: Absolute Solar Absorption
summary: The power to store an infinite or nearly infinite amount of solar-based energies in your body. Advanced version of Solar Energy Absorption. Variation of Absolute Energy Absorption. Not to be confused with Bio-Stellar Transformer.

name: Absolute Sound Absorption
summary: The power to store an infinite or nearly infinite amount of sound in your body. Advanced version of Sound Absorption. Variation of Absolute Energy Absorption. Not to be confused with Bio-Sonic Dynamo.

name: Absolute Stellar Absorption
summary: The power to store an infinite or nearly infinite amount of stellar-based energies in your body. Advanced version of Stellar Energy Absorption. Variation of Absolute Energy Absorption. Not to be confused with Bio-Stellar Transformer.

name: Absolute Thermic Absorption
summary: The power to store an infinite or nearly infinite amount of thermal radiation in your body. Sub-power of Absolute Heat Absorption. Advanced version of Thermal Radiation Absorption. Variation of Absolute Energy Absorption.

name: Absolute Wave Absorption
summary: The power to store an infinite or nearly infinite amounts of waves in your body. Advanced version of Wave Absorption. Variation of Absolute Energy Absorption.

name: Absorbent Creation
summary: The power to create absorbents. Sub-power of Sponge Manipulation. Variation of Object Creation.

name: Absorbent Defense
summary: The ability to use sponges to defend oneself. Technique of Sponge Manipulation. Variation of Defense Powers.

name: Absorbing Regeneration
summary: The power to absorb a variety of things to regenerate. Combination of Absorption and Regenerative Healing Factor. Not to be confused with Mimetic Regeneration.

name: Absorbing Replication
summary: The ability to absorb and replicate anything. Combination of Absorption, Adaptive Replication, and Shapeshifting. Advanced version of Digestive Assimilation.

name: Absorbing Vortex Creation
summary: The power to create an absorbing vortex. Combination of Absorption and Vortex Creation.

name: Absorption
summary: The power to absorb anything and utilize it in some way. Sub-power of Absorption Manipulation. Opposite to Expulsion.

name: Absorption Arts
summary: The power to utilize practices that are assimilative in nature. Variation of Supernatural Arts. Related to Consumption Arts. Not to be confused with Thief Arts.

name: Absorption Attacks
summary: The power to release/use absorption effects for various attacks. Sub-power of Absorption. Variation of Attack Powers. Opposite to Absorption Defense.

name: Absorption Ball Projection
summary: The power to project balls of absorbing energy. Sub-power of Absorption Attacks. Combination of Absorption and Ball Projection.

name: Absorption Beam Emission
summary: The ability to project beams of absorbing energy. Sub-power of Absorption Attacks. Combination of Absorption and Beam Emission.

name: Absorption Blade Construction
summary: The power to create bladed weapons capable of absorption. Variation of Absorption Weaponry and Blade Construction.

name: Absorption Bow Construction
summary: The power to create bow and arrows capable of absorption. Variation of Bow Construction and Absorption Weaponry.

name: Absorption Combat
summary: The ability to combine absorption with physical fighting. Variation of Combat Merging and Absorption. Not to be confused with Theft Combat.

name: Absorption Constructs
summary: The power to create constructs out of absorption power. Sub-power of Absorption and Absorption Manipulation. Variation of Construct Creation.

name: Absorption Defense
summary: The ability to use absorption powers to defend oneself. Variation of Absorption and Defense Powers. Opposite to Absorption Attacks. Not to be confused with Theft Defense.

name: Absorption Empowerment
summary: The power to be empowered by absorption. Combination of Absorption and Affinity. Variation of Absorption Power Link.

name: Absorption Energy Generation
summary: The power to generate absorption energy. Sub-power of Absorption Energy Manipulation. Variation of Energy Generation.

name: Absorption Energy Manipulation
summary: The power to manipulate absorption energy. Variation of Absorption and Energy Manipulation. Not to be confused with Energy Absorption or Parasitic Energy Manipulation.

name: Absorption Field Projection
summary: The power to project a field that absorbs subjects inside of it. Variation of Absorption and Effect Field Projection.

name: Absorption Gun Construction
summary: The power to create guns capable of absorption. Variation of Gun Creation and Absorption Ranged Weaponry.

name: Absorption Infusion
summary: The power to infuse subjects with absorbing effects/energy. Sub-power of Absorption Attacks and Absorption Defense. Technique of Absorption Manipulation. Variation of Absorption and Infusion.

name: Absorption Kiss
summary: The power to drain life-force/energy through lip contact. Variation of Supernatural Kiss and Life-Force Absorption.

name: Absorption Magic
summary: The power to use absorption-based magic. Form of Magic. Variation of Absorption and Absorption Energy Manipulation. Not to be confused with Magical Energy Absorption or Spell Absorption.

name: Absorption Manipulation
summary: The power to control the attributes of absorption.

name: Absorption Mode
summary: The power to enter a state of being with traits and abilities related to absorption/absorption power. Technique of Absorption Element Manipulation, Absorption Energy Manipulation and Absorption Manipulation. Variation of Mode Switching.

name: Absorption Object
summary: Object that grants its user absorption powers. Variation of Powers Via Object.

name: Absorption Polearm Construction
summary: The power to create polearm weapons capable of absorption. Variation of Absorption Weaponry and Polearm Construction.

name: Absorption Power Link
summary: The ability to have one's absorptive nature linked to one's powers. Variation of Self Power Link.

name: Absorption Ranged Weaponry
summary: The ability to deliver absorption attacks using ranged weapons as conduits. Variation of Ranged Power Weaponry and Absorption Weaponry.

name: Absorption Slash
summary: The ability to combine slashing attacks with absorption effects/forces. Combination of Absorption and Cutting. Variation of Slash Effect.

name: Absorption Sword Proficiency
summary: The power to be a master in wielding an absorption-based sword or blade. Variation of Enhanced Swordsmanship.

name: Absorption Weaponry
summary: The power to create and/or use weapons capable of absorption. Variation of Absorption Object and Power Weaponry.

name: Absorption Whip Generation
summary: The power to create or use weapons whips capable of absorption. Variation of Whip Generation and Absorption Weaponry.

name: Absorptive Entity Access
summary: The power to absorb and subjugate any target. Sub-power of Remote Absorbing Replication and Entity Absorption. Variation of Absorbing Replication and Power Absorption.

name: Absorptive Merging
summary: The power to merge with and absorb from a target. Combination of Absorption and Amalgamation. Variation of Fusionism.

name: Accelerated Assimilation
summary: The power to assimilate quickly consumed substances into one's system. Sub-power of Absorption and Metabolization.

name: Adaptation Absorption
summary: The power to absorb adaptations and utilize it in some way. Sub-power Adaptation Manipulation. Variation of Absorption.

name: Adaptive Attribute Assimilation
summary: The power to adapt/augment themselves through experimenting/experiencing. Sub-power of Absorbing Replication and Superior Adaptation. Combination of Adaptation Absorption and Attribute Replication.

name: Almighty Absorbing Replication
summary: The ability to absorb/replicate anything without limit. Combination of Absolute Absorption, Omnifarious and Omnireplication . Ultimate version of Absorbing Replication.

name: Alternate-Self Absorption
summary: The ability to absorb/assimilate alternate versions of oneself to gain power. Sub-power of Alternate-Self Manipulation. Variation of Entity Absorption. Not to be confused with Duplication Absorption or Alternate-Self Merging.

name: Ambient Energy Conversion
summary: The power to absorb ambient energy and convert it to other types of energy. Sub-power of Ambient Energy Manipulation. Combination of Ambient Energy Absorption and Energy Conversion.

name: Anger Absorption
summary: The ability to absorb anger and utilize it in some way. Sub-power of Anger Manipulation. Variation of Emotion Absorption.
